_about: Expected outcome of reproduce/colab/03_reproducible_model.ipynb. 'exact' values follow from the configuration. 'tolerance' values come from the dissertation's v2 run (results/v2), which used the same model, data and hyper-parameters but unseeded patch sampling, so a seeded run lands near, not on, them. Once a run of this notebook is committed as colab_reference.json, later runs are also checked against it exactly.

test.psnr_bicubic.why: same images and same protocol, so bicubic must match

test.psnr_fp32.why: v2 result; differs only by which random patches were drawn
